title: Users
subtitle: Who works in the system and what they can access. The role decides sections and actions.
newHint: Tell the password to the employee in person.

roleHints.Manager: Everything: reports, catalog, users, simulator, log.
roleHints.Chef: Orders, stop list, “What to sell”, stock (view only).
roleHints.Warehouse: Deliveries, stock and write-offs, “What to order”.
roleHints.Simulator: A service account for the simulator — not for signing in.

activeHint: A deactivated user can't sign in, their sessions end.
resetHint: The new password works immediately, all of the user's sessions end.

invites.title: Invites
invites.subtitle: The employee signs up with the code and joins your restaurant with the chosen role. Single use, valid for 7 days.
invites.emptyHint: Choose a role and press “Invite” — the link is copied, send it to the employee.
invites.linkCopied: Link with code {{code}} copied — send it to the employee
invites.copyFailed: Could not copy — write the code down manually
